issues.desc: background.md explains audit mechanics and false-claim risk, but it does not clearly state the user-facing need: after this story the user should know whether Baseline 2-5 may actually start in parallel and what concrete decision this audit unlocks.

The checklist items are framed as internal coordination work (proof audit, contract freeze, dispatch package) rather than user-observable outcomes. Each item should make clear what the user or operator can visibly inspect or do once that item is complete.

The INIT does not define a recognizable completion state from the user perspective. After CHK-001 through CHK-003, it is still unclear whether the result should be a clear go decision, a blocked decision with explicit reason, or another required next step, so the user could still wonder what comes next.
